feeds.title: GoBackpacking
feeds.description: A travel blog with backpacking advice for independent budget travelers. The blog features tips for planning budget trips, with a special focus on around the world travel, plus inspired destination articles, and large photos added daily. Learn to backpack around the world.

feeds.title: Section Hikers Backpacking Blog
feeds.description: Philip Werner is the author of Sectionhiker.com. He is an outdoor writer, guide and educator. His mission is to promote lightweight hiking, backpacking, and mountaineering so that people of all ages can hike safely, comfortably and mindfully.

feeds.title: The Trek
feeds.description: The Trek is All Things Thru-Hiking. We share stories, advice, news, and resources from the Appalachian Trail, Pacific Crest Trail, and all long trails in between.

feeds.title: Journey Era Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Journey Era by Jackson Groves. I've been backpacking and exploring epic locations around the world for over 2 years. I've never spent more than $12 a night on accommodation and am always looking for real adventures like treks, waterfalls and cliff jumping!

feeds.title: Somewhere Sierra
feeds.description: Sierra Ducatt is an Outdoor Photographer and Storyteller exploring the world between the PNW and the SoCal beaches. She writes about her travels to inspire people to get outdoors and hopes the tips, experiences, and ideas shared here help people plan their next adventure.

feeds.title: Hostelworld Blog
feeds.description: We bring you the best news in cheap travel and backpacking tips, top city and destination guides and advice on the best things to see and do - anywhere!

feeds.title: Wild. Blog
feeds.description: Wild. provide guided hiking and backpacking trips to the most extraordinary wild places in the Western United States. Their tours range from high adventure backpacking trips to culturally rich inn-based hiking tours and everything in between. They've been mentioned in the New York Times, Men's Health, Backpacker Magazine and on the Discovery Channel.

feeds.title: Heart My Backpack
feeds.description: I'm Silvia. I blog about life as an American-Norwegian in Norway, as well as my continued travels around the world. My aim is to find a balance between my eagerness to see all the places, and my newfound desire to build a permanent home somewhere.

feeds.title: Adventure Alan
feeds.description: Since 1999 your source for honest & factual information on ultralight backpacking & hiking, backpacking gear, gear reviews, tips and tricks.

feeds.title: We Seek Travel Blog
feeds.description: We Seek Travel is a backpacking, adventure travel blog like no other. Over the past three years, We Seek Travel has published over 400 articles with inspiring photography from some of the best adventure travel destinations on earth. From guides to ocean sailing to minimal van living to trekking in the tallest mountain ranges on earth, We Seek Travel inspires you to get out, explore and enjoy the journey.

feeds.title: The Hiking Life
feeds.description: The Hiking Life is a compilation of tips and advice on trip planning, lightweight backpacking techniques and improving your wilderness skill set. It contains detailed information for more than 170 of the world's great hikes and was put together with the mission of inspiring and enabling folks to go backpacking.

feeds.title: Mind The Travel Blog
feeds.description: The best travel blog for savvy advice and in-depth travel information: Travel Itineraries + Budget Backpacking Tips

feeds.title: I Heart Pacific Northwest
feeds.description: I Heart Pacific Northwest is designed and written by Lisa Holmes, a graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. When I'm not designing websites or print materials at my company, Yulan Studio, I like to spend time exploring the surrounding area. This website contains a trip report from every hike I've done since moving to Oregon.

feeds.title: Planet Of Adventures
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Juan, and this is my Adventure travel blog. Follow my journey around the world backpacking on a budget in search of outdoor adventures wherever I go!

feeds.title: Backpacking With My Lens
feeds.description: Backpacking with my lens is a personal blog curated by Meenakshi Bose who is an avid traveller. She is on a mission to help her fellow travellers by sharing her experiences, curated city guides, travel tips & tricks.

feeds.title: Backpackers Trip
feeds.description: Top Rated Backpacking Gear Reviews, Buying Guide and Comparison Chart are available here to help you find the best backpacking gear.

feeds.title: Backpack.nl Blog
feeds.description: I'm Robbert, the founder of Backpackblog.nl . My hobbies are especially backpacking and sports. Follow this blog for General Inspiration, Specific Tips, Costs, Preparations, Routes and Backpacking Articles in Asia and Australia.

feeds.title: Kat is Travelling
feeds.description: I'm Kat, the writer behind this blog. In September 2015 I quit my job to go backpacking around Australia for a year on a Working Holiday Visa. My love for travel comes from learning about new destinations by immersing myself in their cultural and natural beauty.

feeds.title: ADVENTR.CO
feeds.description: Exploring the secrets of the Colorado Plateau and the Rocky Mountains with my camera. Specializing in Ancient Ruins and Rock Art.

feeds.title: The Backpack Couple
feeds.description: Bounded by our passion for adventure, we embarked on this work in progress journey across seas, sites, tastes and sounds all over the country and beyond documented in this blog space.

feeds.title: Happybackpacker
feeds.description: Happybackpacker is a backpacking travel blog for world travel backpackers. Anja shares her travel reports and tips which help the world traveler travel planning.

feeds.title: Hikematic Articles Blog
feeds.description: Hikematic is your complete guide and go to source to all things outdoors including gear, camping destinations, hiking and guides on various subjects.

feeds.title: South America Backpacker
feeds.description: In 2008, a 23-year old English backpacker called Nikki travelled from the UK to Kathmandu, then onward to Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Cambodia and the rest of South East Asia. She fell in love with the spontaneity of backpacking life and decided there and then that she never wanted to go home. South America Backpacker is about Backpacker stories, tips, events & travel tales about South America.

feeds.title: South East Asia Backpacker
feeds.description: South East Asia Backpacker Magazine is the first and only magazine for independent travellers in South East Asia. South East Asia Backpacker has backpacker stories, tips, events & travel tales. This is the essential magazine for all travellers to South East Asia.

feeds.title: That Backpacker
feeds.description: That Backpacker is a travel blog offering travel tips and inspiration. Follow seasoned backpacker Audrey as she takes you with her on all of her adventures around the world. She also happens to be married to Nomadic Samuel so you can check out both of their Youtube videos from her site.

feeds.title: Hiking Lady Blog
feeds.description: Hiking Lady is an online publication for women who love the outdoors, and choose to explore it by hiking, backpacking, and camping. Additionally, the blog is an up-to-date resource with articles of interest, events, environmental issues, book and movie reviews, organizations to join, and deals on hiking gear and apparel.

feeds.title: Backpacker Banter Travel Blog - Reviews, Advice and Budget Tips
feeds.description: A travel blogging website with heaps of reviews, advice and banter from around the world - covering everything from how to plan a gap year to guest posts from our network of backpackers. It is an award winning travel blog featuring reviews, advice, stories and budgeting tips from around the world.

feeds.title: Adventure In You
feeds.description: Adventure In You is an online adventure travel guide showcasing adventure reviews along with the best travel gear, tips, inspiration, and more. Creators Tom and Anna have been on the road for the last four years and are passionate about helping people create unforgettable memories. Discover personalized destination advice to help you make the most out of every travel experience.

feeds.title: Bearfoot Theory » Wilderness Backpacking
feeds.description: Learn everything you need to know to plan an adventurous backpacking trip including trails, tips, the best gear & most popular backpacking guides. Bearfoot Theory is an outdoor travel blog on a mission to inspire & empower you to get outside with a strong skill set.

feeds.title: Lost With Purpose Blog
feeds.description: Lost With Purpose is a travel blog of an adventure couple backpacking off the beaten track. Deep storytelling, epic photos, and all the useful information a backpacker could need.

feeds.title: The Travelling Tom Blog
feeds.description: The Travelling Tom is dedicated to helping travellers discover the best places in the world to visit. We also show people how they can travel and work!

feeds.title: Average Hiker
feeds.description: Average Hiker is a blog on Hiking and Backpacking. This blog feed contains hiking insights, guides, gear reviews, stories, and a hodgepodge of other mostly hiking-related content about the wilderness and trails the authors love to discuss and recoomend.

feeds.title: Backpack & Explore
feeds.description: Travel Inspiration for people with full-time jobs. Join us as we write the story of our life through Backpack & Explore - our way of discovering life

feeds.title: Cesar and The Woods
feeds.description: This blog is all about wilderness backpacking, camping, nature, the outdoors, etc.

feeds.title: Bemused Backpacker Blog
feeds.description: Bemused Backpacker is the ultimate resource for all backpackers and independent world travellers alike, offering travel advice, education, planning and inspiration for anyone dreaming of their first gap year or planning their next trip.

feeds.title: The Savvy Backpacker
feeds.description: The Savvy Backpacker is an online resource for student and budget travelers that are planning to backpack Europe. The site contains honest and unbiased tips about packing lists, Eurail passes, budget planning, guides to the the best party cities and much more.

feeds.title: My Funky Travel
feeds.description: Backpacking blog with inspiring routes, budget travel tips and plenty more! Here you'll find backpacking tips, articles, routes, suggestions and lots of budget travel inspiration.

feeds.title: Out of Your Comfort Zone Blog
feeds.description: Out of Your Comfort Zone's main goal is to give advice about how to backpack economically and effectively which, for many, can be considered an art.

feeds.title: Tales of a Backpacker Blog
feeds.description: ONE WOMAN. ONE BACKPACK. A WHOLE WORLD TO EXPLORE.Hi! I'm Claire, a 30-something food and travel lover who can't keep still! I'm here to help you travel the world on a budget, while still splurging on once-in-a-lifetime experiences. I have proved that women over 30 can travel solo too, and if I can do it, so can you!

feeds.title: Going Places With Anwesha
feeds.description: Going Places With Anwesha is a female travel blog, created to inspire others to explore the world without any hesitation. Join me on this journey of exploring India and beyond.

feeds.title: Heels In My Backpack
feeds.description: Heels in my Backpack is the go-to blog for girly backpackers looking for advice on fashion, beauty and everything travelling. Heels In My Backpack is your go to place for the backpacking basics.

feeds.title: Backpacking Technology Blog
feeds.description: The Backpacking Technology blog is created and updated by Bob Shaver. He started backpacking in 1967, when he was 17 years old. He has been in Boise for 20 years. In Boise he thought a backpacking class at Boise State U for 12 years, and a class in winter mountaineering and camping for 12 years also.

feeds.title: Little Wanderlust Stories Blog
feeds.description: Little Wanderlust Stories is going to tell you based on my experiences and opinions about my travels around the world. I'm going to give you the full story, the good the bad and the ugly. Off the beaten track, adventure, slow and Solo Travel is what you will find here. I'm all about the budget.

feeds.title: Dare Journey
feeds.description: I set up this blog as a hobby, to showcase my trips, store my travel stories and share my travel tips/ tricks and budget travel guides to my friends and those who love travel with few bucks in pocket.

feeds.title: Backpack & Trail | Backpacking and Camping Gear Reviews
feeds.description: Information and tips for outdoor sports, backpacking, hiking, mountaineering, climbing, canoeing, kayaking, survival, travel reports and outdoor gear reviews

feeds.title: Backpacking Philippines and Asia
feeds.description: A travel blog of Tutubi, an explorer, history/culture buff, living in the make believe world of technology when he'd rather be at a place close to nature.

feeds.title: Nomad Revelations Blog
feeds.description: Nomad Revelations is a famous travel blog by Joao Leitao, with ideas & exotic narratives to inspire independent travelers & audacious backpackers.

feeds.title: Backpackers Travel Magazine
feeds.description: The Backpackers Travel Magazine is the independent backpacking travel guide for backpacker hostels, jobs, tours, working holidays, volunteering, outdoors, gear, camping, hiking, yoga and adventure around the world. . A backpacker magazine for digital nomads, solo female travel and travel writers in New Zealand, Chile, Thailand, South America and Asia. The voice of independent travel.

feeds.title: World Backpacker Global Vagabond
feeds.description: Solo American guy exploring the world, and living overseas nonstop. Find articles about backpacking, solo travel life, and more.

feeds.title: VirtualWayfarer
feeds.description: A blog about Travel with a hostel/backpacking and solo travel emphasis.

feeds.title: Backpackerlee
feeds.description: I am a graduate teacher, language student, and world traveller. Insofar as my online antics are concerned, I am merely an amateur travel blogger. Backpacking (and eating) my way around the world.

feeds.title: Whimsical Hikers
feeds.description: Whimsical Hikers is what happens when you are old enough to know better, not a hiker, and all of the sudden say something like, 'I'm going to do a 50 mile backpacking trip.'

feeds.title: Bunch of Backpackers
feeds.description: I'm Manouk, adventurer and founder of this travel blog 'Bunch of Backpackers' (BoB). With my blog I inspire others to make most out of their travels! I just got back from my magical solo round-the-world trip 'BoB's Epic Adventure'.

feeds.title: The Big Outside
feeds.description: Michael Lanza is an author and the former Northwest Editor of Backpacker Magazine. At The Big Outside, he shares stories and images from his hiking, backpacking, skiing, and paddling adventures, many of them with his family, as well as gear reviews and tips on outdoor skills.

feeds.title: The Pinay Solo Backpacker
feeds.description: Gael Hilotin is a travel blogger from the Philippines. Since 2010, She has written travel features on the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Vietnam. She has contributed to the local and foreign travel news sites, newspapers, and magazines. This blog started out in January 2010 where she aims to inspire her readers to explore the Philippines and the world as well as empower Filipinas through travel. In 2012, she quit her job to travel around the Philippines for 7 months. Gael has visited all 81 provinces in the Philippines.

feeds.title: The Backpack Guide
feeds.description: Welcome to The Backpack Guide! My name is Tucker and I'm excited that you chose The Backpack Guide as your go-to resource for backpack reviews and information. I look forward to helping you find the pack that's perfect for you!

feeds.title: Hiking The Trail Blog
feeds.description: Hiking The Trail is a blog that provides backpacking, hiking, camping. bushcraft, and survival information. It also shares the Adventures of Adam

feeds.title: Backpackers Wanderlust
feeds.description: A backpacking twenty something sharing her best tips, destination guides and personal stories so you have the can have the best adventure exploring the world.

feeds.title: Clever Hiker Blog
feeds.description: Clever Hiker blog features lightweight backpacking video guides and reviews of the best backpacking tents, backpacks, sleeping bags, stoves, and much more. Dave Collins loves outdoor adventure and he has been a backpacker his entire life.

feeds.title: The Backpacking Site Blog
feeds.description: A collection of backpacking travel tips to help you plan your adventures. Blog posts cover itinerary guides, travel ideas, budget tips, essential gear, and stories from the open road.

feeds.title: Trail Recipes Blog
feeds.description: Trail Recipes is a small team of avid hikers passionate about good food and Mother Nature. They share with the world simple, but still tasty recipe we have created in our own adventures on different trails. Follow this blog for a collection of hiking recipes and backpacking food ideas.
